question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker and Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain sandbox-only?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice affects runtime container UX, Docker/Podman setup contracts, and the existing sandbox path convention, so automation should not pick the policy itself.

options.title: Expose a runtime alias
options.body: Add a consistent `/workspace` symlink or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

options.title: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only
options.body: Leave runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Resolve DooD mapping first
options.body: Settle the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker workspaceAccess contract before applying one workspace path policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Expose a runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a consistent `/workspace` symlink or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history signal across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman, and install-test surfaces.
